info.name: WebSankul — Client API
info.description:
Module-wise Client (Mobile/Web) API collection.

## Setup
1. Create a Postman **Environment** and set `BASEURL` to the host root (scheme + host, NO path), e.g. `http://192.168.0.5` or `https://api.websankul.com`. Each request already includes `/api/v1/client/...`.
2. Run **auth > POST Validate OTP** (or your login flow). A test script auto-saves the JWT into `{{token}}`.
3. All authed requests inherit Bearer `{{token}}`. Public routes (otp/refresh/webhooks) use No Auth.
